model_reconstruction.primitive_ontology: mass-density field coupled to collapse noise; definite mass distributions (DP's postulated primitive ontology)
model_reconstruction.noise: Markovian white noise (2007 form) coupling to mass density; non-relativistic
model_reconstruction.gravitational_coupling: collapse timescale set by gravitational self-energy difference E_G between the superposed mass distributions (Penrose heuristic); tau ~ hbar/E_G
model_reconstruction.collapse_prescription: stochastic localization toward one mass-density branch; outcome selection SUPPLIED BY POSTULATED COLLAPSE DYNAMICS, not derived from unitary QM
model_reconstruction.escape_of_C_bp: CONFIRMED — modifies dynamics (Door 1, D1); populations become dynamical outputs of the stochastic law, but the stochastic law itself is an additional postulate

obstruction_state.dp_probability_problem: ORIGINAL (1989-2007) formulation: continuous collapse with energy non-conservation / ill-defined probability functional. Not a logical inconsistency of the general idea; a defect of specific implementations.
obstruction_state.classification: PARTIALLY MATHEMATICAL, PARTIALLY PARAMETER-DEPENDENT — the energy-conservation obstruction is bypassed in the 2007 Markovian form at the cost of an added parameter/assumption
obstruction_state.mass_density_resolution_2013: CONJECTURE — claims the residual issue (systematic energy violation) is resolved by finite mass-density resolution R_0; R_0 is not derived, and the natural value (nuclear size) is now EMPIRICALLY EXCLUDED for nucleons by Donadi et al. 2021
obstruction_state.empirical_frontier: Natural (parameter-free, R_0 = nuclear size) DP: EXCLUDED by underground radiation test. Larger-R_0 variants: constrained but not excluded; trade-off with interferometry/levitated-system bounds and thermal-diffusion degeneracies
obstruction_state.does_dp_solve_outcome_selection: NO in the derived sense — it POSTULATES a stochastic collapse law that yields definite outcomes; the deeper question (why that law, why that probability measure) is relocated, not answered. Probability measure within the model is tied to the noise structure (QND/linear framework), which supplies the Born weights operationally within the model's own postulates.

comparative_status.compression_score_effect: DP gains: outcome definiteness + probability weights + falsifiable parameter space + gravitational linkage. DP costs: added stochastic dynamics, added R_0 parameter, gravity-quantum coupling postulate, natural version excluded.
comparative_status.boundary_theorem_firewall: C_bp theorem used ONLY to classify DP as outside-the-class (Door 1); NOT used as disconfirmation evidence
